sessions.name: Session 2
sessions.description:
Pre-Readings:


  • Seven Questions to Evaluate Network Effect Moats - Platform Chronicles
  • Tactics for Improving Marketplace Quality [Video] - Josh Breinlinger (our guest for today!)


Supplementary Materials:


  • How Defensible are Zoom's Network Effects - Platform Chronicles
  • The Network Effects Manual: 13 Different Network Effects (and counting) - NfX
sessions.summary:
• Gain economic frameworks to understand and manage network d
  • Understand cost/benefit aspects of platform-based network businesses
  • Identify strategic considerations for two-sided and multi-sided platform businesses
  • This lecture covers some of the most fundamental principles behind what makes digital platforms powerful business models.
